applyTo: "{test-plans/*/api/**,api-context/**}"

# API test plans and test cases (full rules: `.claude/skills/api-test-planning/SKILL.md`)

- Plan from the contract: `api-context/<site>/INVENTORY.md`, generated by `npm run api:inventory -- "<contract URL>" --site <site>`. Never hand-edit `INVENTORY.md` or `openapi.json`; re-run the script.
- Layout: `test-plans/<site>/api/test-plan.md` + `test-plans/<site>/api/test-cases/NN-<resource>.md` (readable, numbered).
- **Plain English.** Only the **Endpoint** field (`METHOD /path`) and the **Expected response** field (status code + name, e.g. "**401 Unauthorized**") may be technical. No JSON, code or header syntax.
- Each case `### API-<RES>-<NN> — <title>` has Priority, Type, Endpoint, Before you start, Request, Expected response, Basis, Changes data, Contract reference. Data-driven cases list **Variations** in a table.
- Basis: **Documented in contract** · **Seen in live response** · **Needs confirming**.
- Every documented status code of every in-scope operation has a case, or is excluded in the plan with a reason.
- Contract problems (operations that change data without auth, undocumented error bodies) go in the plan's "Contract findings". Cases state the correct behaviour.
- Cases that change data say how to clean up. Summary counts come from the files.
- **Review before automation.** When the plan and cases are written, leave Status as **Draft**, summarise them for the user and ask them to review and validate. Set Status to **Approved** (with **Reviewed by** name and date) only when they approve. Don't start automating in the same step.
